pages.title: Manifolds and Curvature
pages.text: $(thing)Manifolds and Curvature$()$(br2)Spaces that look flat close up but bend overall, in any number of dimensions. Their total curvature is fixed by their topology (Gauss-Bonnet); string theory asks which six-dimensional one the universe hides.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Topology of Surfaces, Calculus, Curved Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 π Crystal, 1 Möbius Strip.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A closed surface has g handles. Write its total curvature K, the curvature added up over the whole surface.
